# **2\. Domain Invariants**

| Class | Invariant/rule | How protected |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Patient | Name cannot be blank or include numbers. | Protected with input validation. |
| Patient | Contact details cannot be left blank. | Input validation |
| Patient | Patient Id cannot be left blank or be a string | Input validation and type hint |
| Appointment | 1 patient and 1 practitioner per appointment. | Only the option to put 1 of each in. |
|  |  |  |
|  |  |  |

# **3\. Composition / Inheritance Decisions**

| Relationship | Decision | Rationale |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Appointment has a practitioner  | Add | Each appointment can only have one practitioner |
| Appointment has a patient | add | Each appointment can only have one patient |

# **5\. Updated UML**

Insert updated UML only if the implementation revealed a justified design change. Explain every change.

![][image1]

1. New\_patient moved from practitioner to patient as from breif, only employees will be using software.  
2. View\_patient also moved to patient class from Practitioner for same reasons.  
3. All appointment oriented code moved to the appointment class, as it all relates to the appointment.  
4. View\_practitioner and choose\_practitioner moved to the practitioner class as they relate to practitioner.
